title: Business exec landing at O'Hare, all details at once
persona: Mike Donovan, a rushed sales exec talking fast and clipped, dropping words.
goal: Book an airport pickup giving every detail in one breath, then confirm and finish.
opening_line: Yeah hi, need a car, landing O'Hare Friday March 14th, United 482 from Denver, 6:45 PM, two passengers, three bags, sedan, drop at 123 Main Street Evanston, Mike Donovan, 414-555-0111.

turns.caller: That's everything. You got it all?

branches.if_agent: agent asks for a detail already given
branches.caller: I just said that. Friday the 14th, 6:45 PM. Keep going.
No, it's United 482, not 428. Fix that.

turns.caller: Sedan's fine. Black car, whatever you got.
Two people, three bags. Already said.
Hey, how much is that gonna run me?

branches.if_agent: agent declines to quote a price
branches.caller: Okay fine, just send it to dispatch.

turns.caller: Anything else you need? I'm walking into a meeting.

curveballs: All details given in the first utterance
Slight flight number correction if agent misreads
expected: Does not re-ask for details already given
Names the airport by its full name, such as O'Hare International Airport, not a code
Reads back or confirms key details including date, time, flight and passengers
Says the request goes to dispatch or the team
Declines to give a price without inventing one
must_not: Speak an airport code like ORD aloud
Refer to an owner or a named person
